quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #2
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What can speed up alcohol leaving your body?

options.text: Nothing. Only time will remove all alcohol from your body.

questions.correctAnswerText: Nothing. Only time will remove all alcohol from your body.
questions.explanation: Your liver removes about 90 percent of alcohol from your body. It removes alcohol at a constant rate—about one drink per hour. This rate is the same for most people and cannot be faster.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Sudden weather changes mean you should change how you drive.
You should slow down when driving in rain and fog.
Watch for vehicles coming up behind you in bad weather.

questions.explanation: When weather changes suddenly, adjust your driving. Always slow down in rain or fog. Pay attention to vehicles behind you that may be driving too fast for the conditions.

questions.question: Mixing alcohol with drugs can:
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol and drugs can increase the effects of both. It is unsafe to drive after using either one alone. Mixing them together is even more dangerous.

questions.question: If you are in an accident, you should:

options.text: Stop your vehicle at or near the accident scene.
Not stand or walk in traffic lanes.
Turn off the ignitions of damaged vehicles.

questions.explanation: Stop at or near the accident scene. Move your vehicle out of traffic if possible. Do not stand or walk in traffic lanes—another vehicle could hit you. Turn off the ignitions of damaged vehicles.

questions.question: To avoid a truck or bus driver's blind spot, you should:

options.text: Do not drive alongside them and do not tailgate.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive alongside them and do not tailgate.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles like trucks and buses have large blind spots on the sides and rear. Do not drive next to them and do not follow too closely behind them.

questions.question: What can you do from the center turn lane?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane reserved only for vehicles turning left from either direction. You cannot use this lane for passing or for driving straight through.

questions.question: Driving much slower than the speed limit is:
questions.explanation: Driving below the speed limit can be dangerous. Follow the posted speed limits. Slow drivers force other drivers to either creep along behind them or take risks while passing.

questions.question: This sign shows:

options.text: The safest speed in a residential area.
The safest speed for an expressway exit.
The safest speed for an expressway entrance.
The safest speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This speed advisory sign shows the safest speed for a highway exit. In this example, it shows 30 mph.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: You should slow down:

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, on sharp or blind curves, where there are pedestrians or hazards, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on this street. Traffic flows in only one direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a traffic light is coming up ahead. Be ready to stop at a red light or watch for crossing traffic.

questions.question: When you see other drivers acting angry, what should you do?
questions.explanation: If another driver is angry, avoid eye contact and hand gestures. Slow down and move away from them. Keep yourself safe by staying away from the situation.

questions.question: If a police officer stops you, what should you do?

options.text: Unbuckle your seat belt and lower your window.
Get your paperwork ready before the officer reaches your car.
Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel. Wait for the officer to approach.
Get out of your car and walk toward the patrol car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel. Wait for the officer to approach.
questions.explanation: Keep your hands on the steering wheel and stay in your car. Ask any passengers to keep their hands visible too. Don't get out unless the officer tells you to. Wait for the officer to ask for your license, registration, and insurance.

questions.question: How does lack of sleep affect your driving ability?

options.text: The same way driving with teenagers does.

questions.explanation: Tiredness and alcohol have similar effects on driving. Being awake for 18 hours affects your driving like having 0.05% blood alcohol. Being awake for 24 hours affects your driving like having 0.10% blood alcohol.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts drivers that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: At night, what is hardest to see?
questions.explanation: Pedestrians are harder to see at night than road signs and other objects along the road.

questions.question: What happens if you drink alcohol while taking medicine?

options.text: The medicine reduces the effect of the alcohol.
The alcohol helps the medicine work better.
The combination can increase the effects of both.

questions.correctAnswerText: The combination can increase the effects of both.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol with medicine can increase how strong both substances affect you. For example, one drink plus cold medicine could affect you as much as several drinks alone.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: Drive through if no traffic is coming.
Keep driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light is used at dangerous intersections. Always treat it like a stop sign and come to a complete stop.

questions.question: When getting ready to change lanes, you should:

options.text: Turn your head quickly to check for other vehicles.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check both your side and rearview mirrors for traffic behind you. Just before you move into the other lane, look over your shoulder to check for vehicles in your blind spot.

questions.question: When approaching a railroad crossing, you should:
questions.explanation: When you see a railroad crossing sign, slow down, look for a train, and be ready to stop. If red lights are flashing or the gate is down, you must stop 15 to 50 feet before the tracks. Do not try to drive around the gate.

questions.question: You must have a driver license to:

options.text: Buckle a child into a safety restraint system.
Steer a vehicle that is being towed or pushed.
Turn off child locks in a vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer a vehicle that is being towed or pushed.
questions.explanation: You cannot sit in the front seat of a running vehicle without a driver license. You also cannot steer a vehicle while it is being pushed or towed without a license.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road hazards. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a divided highway is coming up ahead.

questions.question: You are driving on a divided multilane highway and see or hear an emergency vehicle approaching. You should:

options.text: Ignore the signal if other lanes are available for the emergency vehicle.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Slow down, move to give the emergency vehicle a clear path, and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move to give the emergency vehicle a clear path, and stop.
questions.explanation: If you see flashing lights or hear a siren from an emergency vehicle, slow down, clear a path for it, and stop. Do not try to outrun the emergency vehicle.

questions.question: When a funeral procession is present, ____ has the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Drivers, pedestrians, and bicyclists must yield to funeral processions. When the lead vehicle enters an intersection, the rest of the procession can follow through, even if a traffic light says to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. You must yield to any vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection or heading toward it. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: If your license has been suspended for a third time due to the point system, it will be suspended for:
questions.explanation: In North Carolina, you lose points for traffic violations. A first suspension lasts 60 days. A third suspension due to points lasts 12 months.

questions.question: Before entering a roundabout, you must slow down and yield to:
questions.explanation: Before entering a roundabout, yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and vehicles already in the roundabout.

questions.question: About what percentage of highway deaths involve alcohol?
questions.explanation: About 38 percent of all traffic deaths involve alcohol.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking is reserved for people with disabled parking permits
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow
This lane is reserved for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking is reserved for people with disabled parking permits
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts to cross in front of your vehicle. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrian
Stop and let the pedestrian cross

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian cross
questions.explanation: Always stop for pedestrians in the roadway. Be extra careful around children. Pedestrians in a crosswalk have the right-of-way.

questions.question: Two solid white lines across a traffic lane mark a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Vehicles have the right-of-way over pedestrians in crosswalks
Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk
Pedestrians must stay out of the way of all traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show where pedestrians can safely cross. You must always stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk.

questions.question: A driver who goes much slower than the speed limit:

options.text: Should not let following cars pass
May create a dangerous driving environment

questions.correctAnswerText: May create a dangerous driving environment
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic can be hazardous. On two-lane roads, you must pull over and let faster traffic pass. Only drive significantly below the speed limit when conditions require it.

questions.question: When you see a steady yellow traffic light, you should:

options.text: Speed up to avoid a red light
Keep driving because you have the right-of-way
Slow down and stop, unless you are already in the intersection
Check what the cars next to you are doing

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop, unless you are already in the intersection
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a red light is coming. Stop unless you are already in the intersection.
